    AI Overview
    Top new shows to stream in early 2026 include gripping thrillers and fantasy dramas. Highlights include
    Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen (Rotten Tomatoes), BAIT, Jo Nesbo's Detective Hole, and the highly anticipated Daredevil: Born Again. Also, Netflix's Beauty in Black is drawing high viewership, while How to Make a Killing (PVOD) offers a stylish crime thriller. 
    Best New Streaming Shows (April 2026): 
    • Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen (Netflix): A highly-rated new series (88% audience score) quickly gathering attention.
    • BAIT (Netflix): A top-rated thriller boasting a 97% fresh audience score.
    • Daredevil: Born Again (Disney+):
      A highly anticipated addition to the Marvel streaming lineup.
    • Jo Nesbo's Detective Hole (BBC/Various): A thrilling adaptation of the renowned crime series.
    • Beauty in Black (Netflix): Tyler Perry's new dramatic series currently ranking in the top 10.
    • How to Make a Killing (PVOD): Starring Glen Powell in a dark, charming, and suspenseful thriller.
    • Run Away (Netflix): A gripping, fast-paced thriller based on a Harlan Coben novel.
    • The 'Burbs (Netflix): A comedic television remake starring Keke Palmer.
    • Love Story (Netflix): Ryan Murphy's latest, focusing on the story of JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette. 
    Note: The ratings and popularity are based on early 2026 data.
